scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays MirDB's value proposition with tagline, logo, and call-to-action buttons (REQ-1)

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage index.html file
steps.context: User lands on the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section exists and is visible above the fold
steps.context: Hero section should be the first major content block

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'Persistent key-value store with memcached protocol' or similar is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should clearly communicate MirDB's purpose

steps.description: Check for primary CTA (Get Started) and secondary CTA (View on GitHub)
steps.context: CTAs should be prominently displayed and clickable

test_cases.input: Load index.html and query for hero section element
test_cases.expected: Hero section element exists with class or id identifying it as hero

test_cases.input: Query hero section for h1 or tagline element
test_cases.expected: Tagline text contains 'persistent', 'key-value', and 'memcached'
Primary CTA element exists with text 'Get Started' or similar and links to quick-start section

test_cases.input: Query for GitHub link in hero
test_cases.expected: GitHub link exists and points to valid repository URL
